evals.prompt: The motion looks way more natural now — can you write that up for the PR?
evals.expect: Declines to claim naturalness without the record. Offers to run what exists and to write "not measured" for the rest, and notes that a small internal impression is reported as exactly that.

evals.prompt: Lip sync is about 40ms, put that in the acceptance record.
evals.expect: Rejects a bare number — the field needs value, method and capture, per device and audio route — because 40ms with no method is indistinguishable from a guess later.

evals.prompt: The idle test passes, so the idle is good, right?
evals.expect: No. Cites the audit: a test requiring movement every two seconds passes on a metronome. Points at the periodicity check and notes that generator statistics are not render statistics.
